DHA-84.purpose: Form 11 — application for a port of entry visa or transit visa.
doNotUseFor: temporary residence visa applications over 90 days
questions: identity and previous names
date/country/gender/nationality and nationality acquisition
passport/travel-document number, issuer, type and expiry
normal residence, contact details and period resident
occupation/employer or self-employment
marital status and spouse particulars where applicable
arrival date/place, purpose, duration and entries
South African residential address and host/hotel
South African host identity/PR number where applicable
organisations/persons to be contacted

prior settlement applications, refusals, deportation/removal, convictions, pending criminal action, insolvency, infectious disease/physical or mental deficiency, judicial incompetence, and relevant organisation/security questions
affirmative-answer particulars
transit destination, travel mode, departure details and destination visa where applicable
official/declaration/signature information
supportingEvidence: documents showing purpose/duration of visit or host invitation

DHA-1738.purpose: Form 8 — application for a temporary residence visa.
doNotUseFor: port-of-entry/transit visitor applications handled by DHA-84
questions: route-specific visa category and purpose
applicant identity, citizenship, passport and contact information
current immigration status and previous South African visas/permits
South African address and contact details
spouse/children/dependants where relevant
employment/business/study/medical/retirement/relative/other route-specific facts
financial support and undertaking information
security, criminal, health and prior immigration history
supporting-document completeness and validity dates
DHA-1738.note: This repository PDF is interactive and contains an actual AcroForm field structure; its exact field names and widget rectangles are recorded in the generated field map.

BI-947.purpose: Form 18 — application for a permanent residence permit.
useWhen: permanent residence applications under the applicable category/ground
questions: principal applicant title, names, former names, date/country of birth, nationality, passport and marital/spousal status
marriage/relationship history, divorce/separation and custody/maintenance history
current and postal addresses, contact details, occupation and temporary permit history
parents' particulars
spouse particulars and spouse's parents where applicable
all biological/adopted children and which children will apply
relatives/friends in South Africa
full employment record
present/last duties and intended occupation in South Africa
funds to be transferred, pension/private income and assets
language proficiency
family remaining in country of origin

criminal convictions, insolvency, civil actions, debts, pending enquiries, previous PR/refusals/removals/deportations, previous South African residence, health-related questions, other spousal relationships and asylum applications elsewhere
South African contact and spouse employment details
signatures and dates
supportingEvidence: medical and radiological reports where applicable
category-specific evidence listed in the form

BI-1712A.purpose: Form 12 — affidavit in respect of parties to a permanent spousal relationship.
useWhen: initial permanent spousal relationship application (Part A)
partAQuestions: citizen/permanent-resident/foreigner partner identity, gender, address, ID/passport, nationality, birth date, first entry, permit and expiry
foreign partner identity, address, passport, birth/place of birth, nationality, first entry, visa/permit and expiry
relationship duration and intention of permanence/exclusivity
whether either person has another marriage/spousal relationship
evidence proving cohabitation and shared financial responsibilities
signatures and Commissioner of Oaths details
partBQuestions: confirmation that the spousal relationship still subsists
signatures and Commissioner of Oaths details
sourceRefs: South African High Commission downloadable forms
